title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027/28 – Fully Funded Master's in the UK
summary: Full master's funding at a participating UK university: tuition, return flights and a monthly stipend of £1,712 (£2,000 in London). Open to citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries, including Rwanda, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Ghana and Nigeria, who have a 2:1 degree, have not studied or worked a year or more in a high-income country, and cannot afford UK study otherwise. Apply online via CSC Central before 16:00 GMT on 8 December 2026.

title: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP) 2027
summary: One of Europe's most prestigious master's scholarships: a tuition waiver plus CHF 13,500 per semester for living costs. Open to all nationalities who graduated in the top 10% of their Bachelor's. You apply together with your Master's application on eApply. Note the deadline is 30 November 2026 at 11:59 in the MORNING (Swiss time), not midnight.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2027 – Fully Funded Postgraduate Study at Cambridge
summary: Full-cost scholarships for outstanding applicants from outside the UK to do a postgraduate degree (master's or PhD) at the University of Cambridge. You apply through Cambridge's graduate application and complete the Gates section. Deadlines depend on your course: 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027 (11:59pm UK time). Check your course's funding deadline first.

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Sciences Po 2027 (Master's in Paris)
summary: Covers the full financial needs of African students admitted to a two-year master's at Sciences Po in Paris. You must hold African citizenship only, be under 35 on 1 September 2027, and not already hold a master's. Apply by 23 November 2026 for an early admission decision, or by 14 December 2026 at the latest. Results in April 2027.

title: Mastercard Foundation AfOx Graduate Scholarships – Oxford MBA 2027-28
org: Saïd Business School, University of Oxford
summary: Up to three scholarships for African nationals or residents joining the Oxford MBA, covering course fees and a living-costs grant, plus leadership training and networking. There is no separate scholarship form: submit your Oxford MBA application by 6 January 2027 and show your commitment to Africa's development.

title: KU Leuven Scholarships 2027-28: Scholarship for Africa, Master Mind & Inspiring the Outstanding
summary: One application puts you forward for three master's scholarships at KU Leuven in Belgium. Scholarship for Africa: full tuition waiver plus €4,000 for nationals and residents of listed African countries. Master Mind: €10,750 (all nationalities). Inspiring the Outstanding: tuition waiver plus €13,200 per year. Submit your master's application with the candidacy form AND register online by 15 January 2027, 23:59 CET.

title: Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals 2027/28
summary: Fully funded master's studies in Sweden for future leaders with work and leadership experience from 34 eligible countries (check the list). IMPORTANT, two steps: first apply to an eligible master's programme at universityadmissions.se by 15 January 2027, then apply for the scholarship between 8 and 24 February 2027 (closes 14:59 CET).
